findings: the constants JSON over-publishes its own precision: eta_beta carries a final digit the 100-digit computation behind it does not support, out of 4 transcendental constants checked. Same class as item 45 (RUN-027), second occurrence and far milder. The three exponent figures are exactly rational and are right to every published digit.

the per-row `primitive_error` is published to 100 significant digits at every convergent while the computation behind it supports between 83 and 100, and the shortfall is exactly the cancellation in `p - beta*q`: predicted by `log10(beta*q*q+)` to within 2.0 digits at every row, always conservatively. The two capacity fields are unaffected: none is over-published.
